_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Declares the two schemas for consumption-based (usage) billing: UsageRatePlan (the flat or graduated-tier price book) and MeterReading (a metered quantity over a period). OCA\Shillinq\Service\UsageRatingCalculator rates a reading against its plan, and OCA\Shillinq\Service\InvoiceGenerationService drives the new 'usage' billing model through the EXISTING draftInvoice/postInvoice pipeline (BillingModelEngine::calculateUsage) — no fork of invoicing. Extends shillinq's flat recurring + retainer billing to metered/usage billing (REQ-UMB-001..004).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Usage Rate Plan is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

UsageRatePlan.title: Usage Rate Plan
UsageRatePlan.description: Price book for consumption-based billing (REQ-UMB-001). A plan rates a metered resource either `flat` (quantity x unitPriceCents) or `graduated` (the quantity is split across ascending tiers, each slice priced at its tier unitPriceCents; the final tier's upTo is null and catches all remaining volume). Declares the VAT rate and revenue account so a rated line flows straight into the existing invoice pipeline.

resourceType.description: The metered resource this plan prices (e.g. api_calls, kwh, storage_gb).
resourceType.title: Resource Type

unit.description: Unit of measure the quantity is expressed in.
unit.title: Unit

ratingMethod.description: flat = quantity x unitPriceCents; graduated = tiered slices priced per tier.
ratingMethod.title: Rating Method

unitPriceCents.description: Flat price per unit in integer cents. Required when ratingMethod=flat; ignored for graduated.
unitPriceCents.title: Unit Price Cents

tiers.description: Graduated pricing tiers, ascending by upTo. Each tier prices the slice of quantity between the previous tier cap and its own upTo (null upTo = unbounded final tier).
tiers.title: Tiers

upTo.description: Upper bound (inclusive cap) of this tier in units; null for the unbounded final tier.
upTo.title: Up To

unitPriceCents.description: Price per unit within this tier, integer cents.
unitPriceCents.title: Unit Price Cents

vatRate.description: VAT percentage applied to rated lines (Dutch statutory rate; default 21).
vatRate.title: VAT Rate

glRevenueAccount.description: Optional revenue account override; usage revenue defaults to 4500.
glRevenueAccount.title: GL Revenue Account

currency.description: ISO 4217 plan currency (defaults to the administration functional currency).
currency.title: Currency

effectiveFrom.description: ISO date the plan becomes effective.
effectiveFrom.title: Effective From

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Meter Reading is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

MeterReading.title: Meter Reading
MeterReading.description: A metered quantity of a resource consumed by a customer over a billing period (REQ-UMB-002). Rated by UsageRatingCalculator against its UsageRatePlan into a BillableInvoiceLine through the existing invoice pipeline. Lifecycle: unrated -> rated -> invoiced (REQ-UMB-004) so a reading is never double-billed.

meterId.description: Stable identifier of the meter/subscription the reading came from.
meterId.title: Meter ID

customerId.description: FK to the customer being billed for this usage.
customerId.title: Customer ID

quantity.description: Metered quantity in the plan's unit.
quantity.title: Quantity

unit.description: Unit of measure (redundant with the plan; kept for readability).
unit.title: Unit

ratePlanId.description: FK to the UsageRatePlan this reading is rated against; falls back to the request default.
ratePlanId.title: Rate Plan ID

periodStart.description: ISO start of the metered period.
periodStart.title: Period Start

periodEnd.description: ISO end of the metered period.
periodEnd.title: Period End

description.description: Optional line description override; a readable default is synthesised when absent.
description.title: Description

invoiceId.description: FK to the BillableInvoice this reading was billed on (set on transition to invoiced).
invoiceId.title: Invoice ID

rated.label: Rated
rated.description: Priced against its UsageRatePlan; ready to invoice.

invoiced.label: Invoiced
invoiced.description: Billed onto a BillableInvoice; invoiceId set (REQ-UMB-004).

rate.label: Rate reading
rate.description: Price the reading against its UsageRatePlan.

invoice.label: Add to invoice
invoice.description: Attach the rated line to a BillableInvoice.
